tasks.title: Breakfast - Avocado Toast with Tomato & Spinach
tasks.description: Whole grain toast topped with mashed avocado, sliced tomatoes, and sautéed spinach; seasoned with lemon and olive oil.
ingredients: 2 slices whole grain bread

5 cherry tomatoes, sliced
1 cup fresh spinach
1 tsp olive oil
1 tsp lemon juice
Salt and pepper to taste

ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa (dry)
1 cup cooked chickpeas
1/2 cucumber, diced
1/2 red bell pepper, diced
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
2 tbsp tahini
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp olive oil
